Rashi on Berakhot 57a:10:1.english: Will become head of the yeshiva - For he proclaims and commands the public.

Rashi on Berakhot 57a:10:2.hebrew: אני ראיתיה וכו' - ועל כן נעשיתי ראש ישיבה במתא מחסיא:
Rashi on Berakhot 57a:10:2.english: I saw it, etc. - And therefore I became head of the yeshiva in Mata Meḥasya.

Rashi on Berakhot 57a:11:1.hebrew: תרביצא - גינה, א"נ בהמ"ד. תרביצא נאה וגילה — נוטריקון של תרנגול:
Rashi on Berakhot 57a:11:1.english: A garden - [Means] a garden, or alternatively a study hall. "A beautiful garden and rejoicing" [tarbitza na'ah vegila] is an acronym of tarnegol [rooster].

Rashi on Berakhot 57a:11:2.hebrew: תלויה בקשתו - בספק, כביצים הללו שהאוכל סתום בם:
Rashi on Berakhot 57a:11:2.english: His request is pending - [It is] in doubt, like these eggs in which the food is sealed within them.

Rashi on Berakhot 57a:11:3.english: [If] they broke - The food was revealed.

Rashi on Berakhot 57a:12:1.english: And He led them to a haven - That is a city.

Rashi on Berakhot 57a:12:2.hebrew: חפצם - סימן הוא להיות חפציו נעשים:
Rashi on Berakhot 57a:12:2.english: Their desire - It is a sign that his desires will be fulfilled.

Rashi on Berakhot 57a:12:3.hebrew: המגלח - סימן גדולה ותפארת היא לו, כמו ויגלח ויחלף וגו' (בראשית מא):
Rashi on Berakhot 57a:12:3.english: One who shaves - It is a sign of greatness and glory for him, as in: "And he shaved and changed [his garments], etc." (Genesis 41).

Rashi on Berakhot 57a:13:1.english: In a boat - In a ship.

Rashi on Berakhot 57a:13:2.english: That it is raised up - That it travels high upon the sea.

Rashi on Berakhot 57a:14:1.hebrew: הנפנה - סימן הוא שסרחונו וגנותו נפרש ויוצא מעליו:
Rashi on Berakhot 57a:14:1.english: One who defecates - It is a sign that his foulness and disgrace are separated and depart from him.

Rashi on Berakhot 57a:14:2.english: And that is provided that he did not wipe - That he did not soil his hands.

Rashi on Berakhot 57a:15:1.hebrew: בבבל עומד בלא חטא - לפי שחו"ל אין לה זכיות, אלא עון יש בישיבתה, וזה עומד ערום בלא אותם עונות:
Rashi on Berakhot 57a:15:1.english: In Babylonia, he stands without sin - Because outside the Land [of Israel] has no merits, but rather there is sin in dwelling in it, and this [person] stands naked without those sins.

Rashi on Berakhot 57a:15:2.hebrew: בא"י - שהרבה מצות תלויות בה, וזה העומד ערום — סימן שהוא ערום ממצותיה:
Rashi on Berakhot 57a:15:2.english: In Eretz Yisrael - For many mitzvot are dependent upon it, and this one who is standing naked — it is a sign that he is bare of its mitzvot.

Rashi on Berakhot 57a:15:3.hebrew: הנתפש לסרדיוט - שומרין אותו שלא יברח, אלמא סימן שמירה הוא — ששומרים אותו מידי היזק:
Rashi on Berakhot 57a:15:3.english: One who is apprehended by a soldier - They guard him so that he will not escape; hence, it is a sign of protection — that they protect him from harm.

Rashi on Berakhot 57a:16:1.hebrew: אגם - שיש בו קנים גדולים וקטנים וסמוכים זה לזה — סימן לראש ישיבה, שהגדולים והקטנים מתקבצים יחד קבוץ גדול, ובאים לשמוע דרשה מפיו:
Rashi on Berakhot 57a:16:1.english: A marsh - Since it has reeds, large and small, that are close to one another — [this is] a sign of the head of a yeshiva, for the great and the small gather together in a large assembly and come to hear a discourse from his mouth.

Rashi on Berakhot 57a:16:2.hebrew: יער - אילנות גדולים, ואינן סמוכים זה לזה. אף זה סימן לראש לתלמידי הרב, והוא ראש לבני כלה, שמפרש לתלמידים שמועתם אחר שעמד הרב והם מחזרין על שמועתם, ויש תלמידים שלא יבינו בדברי הרב ככל הצורך, וזה מבינה להם:
Rashi on Berakhot 57a:16:2.english: A forest - [There are] large trees, and they are not close to one another. This too is a sign of a leader among the master's students, and that is the head of the students of the Kallah, who explains to the students their lesson after the master has stood up [concluding the lecture] and they are reviewing their lesson; and there are students who did not understand the master's words as fully as needed, and this [one] explains it to them.

Rashi on Berakhot 57a:17:1.hebrew: תלי טבלא - נראה לו שהיה זוג וענבל תלוי בצוארו ומשמיע קול. והוא סימן לראש ישיבה, שמשמיע קול לרבים:
Rashi on Berakhot 57a:17:1.english: A bell was hanging - It appeared to him that a bell and clapper was hanging around his neck and making sound. And this is a sign of [becoming] the head of a yeshiva, who makes his voice heard to the public.

Rashi on Berakhot 57a:17:2.hebrew: ונבחי בה נבוחי - קשקשתי בה בקול:
Rashi on Berakhot 57a:17:2.english: And I sounded it with a sound - I rang it loudly.

Rashi on Berakhot 57a:18:1.hebrew: עונותיו מחולין לו - לפי שהעונות קרויין אדומים, שנאמר: אם יאדימו כתולע (ישעיהו א׳:י״ח), ואומר: נכתם עונך (ירמיהו ב׳:כ״ב) — וסימן הוא שפורשין ממנו:
Rashi on Berakhot 57a:18:1.english: His transgressions are forgiven him - Because transgressions are called red, as it is stated: "Though they be red like crimson" (Isaiah 1:18), and it says: "Your iniquity is stained" (Jeremiah 2:22) — and it is a sign that they depart from him.

Rashi on Berakhot 57a:1:1.hebrew: דמסרג - שיש לו אוכף על גביו יפה:
Rashi on Berakhot 57a:1:1.english: That it is saddled - That it has a saddle properly on its back.

Rashi on Berakhot 57a:1:2.hebrew: נס נעשה לו - נו"ן כנגד נו"ן, וכגון שראה השם כתוב:
Rashi on Berakhot 57a:1:2.english: A miracle will be performed for him - [The letter] nun [in Huna] corresponds to [the letter] nun [in nes, miracle], and [this is] such as where he saw the name written.

Rashi on Berakhot 57a:1:4.hebrew: והני מילי בכתבא - אכולהו קאי — שראה הונא או חנינא, או תיבה זו של הספד כתובה, דמשמע חסו עליו ופדאוהו:
Rashi on Berakhot 57a:1:4.english: And this applies [only] in writing - [This] refers to all of them — that he saw [the name] Huna or Ḥanina, or this word of "hespeid" [eulogy] written, which signifies: "They had mercy on him and redeemed him."

Rashi on Berakhot 57a:20:1.hebrew: פרנסתו מזומנת - כנחש, שעפר לחמו ומצוי לו בכל מקום:
Rashi on Berakhot 57a:20:1.english: His livelihood is accessible - Like a snake, whose food is dust and is available to it everywhere.

Rashi on Berakhot 57a:20:2.english: [If] he killed it - [Meaning,] the snake.

Rashi on Berakhot 57a:20:3.hebrew: כל שכן שנכפלה לו - שהרי נתגבר עליו:
Rashi on Berakhot 57a:20:3.english: All the more so that it is doubled for him - For he prevailed over it.

Rashi on Berakhot 57a:20:4.hebrew: ולא היא - אלא רב ששת דורש להנאתו, לפתור חלומו לטובה:
Rashi on Berakhot 57a:20:4.english: And that is not so - Rather, Rav Sheshet expounded for his own benefit, to interpret his dream favorably.

Rashi on Berakhot 57a:21:1.hebrew: יש שותהו כו' - לפיכך אין לעמוד על פתרונו:
Rashi on Berakhot 57a:21:1.english: There is one who drinks it, etc. - Therefore, one cannot determine its interpretation.

Rashi on Berakhot 57a:3:1.hebrew: דלא סיים - שנעור משנתו קודם שנסתלק, סימן הוא שסמוך אצל הקב"ה:
Rashi on Berakhot 57a:3:1.english: That he did not finish - That he awoke from his sleep before he departed [from prayer] — it is a sign that he is close to the Holy One, blessed be He.

Rashi on Berakhot 57a:4:1.hebrew: מובטח לו שהוא בן העולם הבא - ונוטל חלקו וחלק חברו בגן עדן, דדמי לאשת איש:
Rashi on Berakhot 57a:4:1.english: He is assured that he is destined for the World-to-Come - And he takes his portion and his fellow's portion in the Garden of Eden, for [this] is similar to [taking] a married woman.

Rashi on Berakhot 57a:7:2.hebrew: יצפה לתורה - שנאמר: ״אשקך מיין הרקח״ — היינו תורה:
Rashi on Berakhot 57a:7:2.english: He should anticipate Torah - As it is stated: "I would cause you to drink of spiced wine" — that is Torah.

Rashi on Berakhot 57a:7:3.english: Of the juice of my pomegranate - That which is squeezed from the pomegranates.

Rashi on Berakhot 57a:9:1.hebrew: נכסיו מצליחין - כהדס זה, שעליו משולשים זה על זה כמין קליעה:
Rashi on Berakhot 57a:9:1.english: His property will prosper - Like this myrtle, whose leaves are arranged in threes, one over the other, like a braid.

Rashi on Berakhot 57a:9:2.english: On their stem - On their base — in their place, attached [to the ground].
